key.formula: Laplace margin density: f(m|mu,b) = (1/(2b))*exp(-|m-mu|/b); F(m|mu,b) = 0.5*exp((m-mu)/b) for m<mu, 1 - 0.5*exp(-(m-mu)/b) for m>=mu; closed-form CRPS_Laplace(mu,b;y) = |y-mu| + b*exp(-|y-mu|/b) - (3/4)*b, with scale b(T,S) = sigma(T,S)/sqrt(2)

key.formula: Predict: x_hat_{k|k-1} = F*x_hat_{k-1|k-1}, P_{k|k-1} = F*P_{k-1|k-1}*F^T + Q_k with F = [[1,0,dt,0],[0,1,0,dt],[0,0,1,0],[0,0,0,1]]; Update: y_k = z_k - H_obs*x_hat_{k|k-1}; S_k = H_obs*P_{k|k-1}*H_obs^T + R_k; K_k = P_{k|k-1}*H_obs^T*S_k^{-1}; Joseph form P_{k|k} = (I4 - K_k*H_obs)*P_{k|k-1}*(I4 - K_k*H_obs)^T + K_k*R_k*K_k^T
key.symbols: x_k=[x,y,vx,vy]^T field meters and m/s; z_k=[zx,zy]^T projected 2D field measurement; H_obs=[I2 | 0_{2x2}]; dt = 0.10 s at 10 Hz (0.0167 s at 60 Hz broadcast)

key.formula: Naive (book) parlay price = product of leg probabilities: 'Books price the parlay as independent multiplicative legs (0.562 × 0.551 = 31.0%)'; 4-leg version stated as 'Sportsbooks price this as independent multiplication (9.80% implied ≈ +920 to +1100)'

key.formula: Vector-field pitch gravity: u(x,t) = sum_i w_i(t)*K(x - p_i,t)*v_i,t / sum_i w_i(t)*K(x - p_i,t) with anisotropic Gaussian kernel K; Helmholtz-Hodge u(x) = -grad Phi(x) + curl A(x); under near-irrotational team motion (curl u ~ 0) field follows Poisson's equation grad^2 Phi(x) = -rho_gravity(x), rho_gravity(x) = sum_j q_j^def*delta(x-p_j) - sum_k q_k^off*delta(x-p_k)
key.symbols: 0.5 x 0.5 yard mesoscale grid cells Omega_m,n; w_i(t) positional influence weight; E_gravity = -grad Phi_def; running lanes = potential wells where grad P = rho*(u dot grad)u diverges

key.formula: Pitch Control Field PCF(x1) = sigma_logistic( (T_def(x1) - max(T_off(x1), t_b(x1))) / sigma_arr ); EPV(x1) = PCF(x1) * E[EP_nflfastR(x1 + YAC(PCF))]; ball time-of-flight t_b(x1 | x_QB, v_pass) = ||x1 - x_QB||_2 / v_pass(theta_launch, rho_air)

key.formula: C(x) = [q̂_α/2(x) − Q̂_{1−α}(E), q̂_{1−α/2}(x) + Q̂_{1−α}(E)]; band expanded by 'the (1−α)(1+1/n)-th empirical quantile of the calibration scores' — both notations quoted exactly as written in the doc
key.symbols: C(x) = prediction interval at test input x; q̂_α/2(x) = lower quantile regressor evaluated at x; q̂_{1−α/2}(x) = upper quantile regressor evaluated at x; Q̂_{1−α}(E) = empirical quantile of the calibration conformity scores E = {E_i}; n = calibration-set size; α = miscoverage rate. Band expanded outward by Q̂_{1−α}(E) on both endpoints.

key.formula: Two-thirds power law of drawing kinematics: v(t) = gamma * kappa(t)^{-beta} (equivalently omega(t) = C * kappa(t)^{2/3}), beta ~= 1/3; dynamic jerk functional J = integral_0^T ||r'''(t)||_2^2 dt; dimensionally normalized jerk NJ = (T^5/L^2) * integral_0^T ||r'''(t)||_2^2 dt; curvature kappa(t) = |x'(t)y''(t) - x''(t)y'(t)| / (x'(t)^2 + y'(t)^2)^{3/2}
key.symbols: r(t)=(x(t),y(t)) planar curve in C^3; v tangential speed; gamma piecewise-constant velocity gain; omega angular speed; L movement amplitude, T duration. NOTE: non-NFL domain (digital pen neurodegeneration telemetry) but the curvature/power-law machinery is the same kinematic form used for receiver route curvature.

key.formula: E_i = max{q̂_α/2(X_i) − Y_i, Y_i − q̂_{1−α/2}(X_i)} (verbatim CQR conformity score; the doc says these 'measure how far the true response falls outside the estimated quantile band')
key.symbols: E_i = conformity (nonconformity) score for calibration point i; α = miscoverage rate (target coverage 1−α); X_i = covariate of calibration point i; Y_i = true response of calibration point i; q̂_α/2 = lower quantile regressor fitted at level α/2; q̂_{1−α/2} = upper quantile regressor fitted at level 1−α/2. Sign convention: max of two one-sided signed terms (lower-quantile minus Y; Y minus upper-quantile) — no absolute value.

Structural Alpha Lift: +108.2% (z = 58.85)' (4-leg); fair price from joint: '20.41% (+390 true fair price)', '39.25% (Fair Price +155)'
key.symbols: True Joint = Student-t copula joint probability (ν = 4.0, 50,000 draws, empirical 8×8 matrix); Independent = multiplicative product of leg probabilities; lift = stated relative lift (arithmetic recompute: (39.25-30.98)/30.98 = +26.69% ≈ stated +26.68%; (20.41-9.80)/9.80 = +108.27% ≈ stated +108.2%); z = stated z-score; +390 = American odds for 20.41% (recompute 100/490 = 20.408%); +155 = American odds for 39.25% (recompute 100/255 = 39.22%, rounding)

key.formula: [the α-th quantile of {μ̂_{−i}(X_{n+1}) − |Y_i − μ̂_{−i}(X_i)|}, the (1−α)-th quantile of {μ̂_{−i}(X_{n+1}) + |Y_i − μ̂_{−i}(X_i)|}] (verbatim jackknife+ interval construction)
key.symbols: μ̂_{−i} = regression function fitted leaving out training point i; X_{n+1} = test point; (X_i, Y_i), i=1..n = training data; n = training-set size; α = miscoverage rate. key.steps: Bin forecasts into n_bins=10; compute base_rate; for each bin compute n_k, f_k, o_k; REL += (n_k/N)((f_k-o_k)^2); RES += (n_k/N)((o_k-base_rate)^2); UNC = base_rate(1-base_rate); BS = REL - RES + UNC; raise fatal calibration error if REL > UNC.

key.name: Shin de-vig probability extraction
key.steps: pi = 1/O; define objective_z(z)=sum((sqrt(z^2+4(1-z)pi^2)-z)/(2(1-z)))-1; brentq over z in [0,0.999); return objective probabilities; raise fail-closed ValueError if the root search fails. NOTE: cited without a printed primary page (unverified synthesis).

key.name: Fail-closed PIT join primitives

key.name: Calibration layer hierarchy

key.name: Fixture guard (phantom-fixture refusal)

key.name: Matrix Frobenius shrinkage (player x metric)
key.steps: 1) U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(X, full_matrices=False). 2) p = S.shape[0]. 3) for i in range(p): shrink = max(0.0, 1.0 - (sigma_sq*(p - 2))/max(S[i]**2, 1e-12)); shrunk_S[i] = S[i]*shrink. 4) return U @ np.diag(shrunk_S) @ Vt. (Declared arg target_rank=2 is unused in the shown body.)

key.name: Jackknife+ interval construction
key.steps: Fit n leave-one-out models mu_{-i}; compute LOO residuals R_i^{LOO}; build the union interval [q_alpha^-(mu_{-i}(X_{n+1})-R_i^{LOO}), q_{1-alpha}^+(mu_{-i}(X_{n+1})+R_i^{LOO})]; guarantees at least 1-2alpha coverage with no sample-splitting loss.

key.name: Empirical-Bayes James-Stein shrinkage for sparse comparison graphs
key.steps: Compute raw MLE log-utilities u_hat_i; compute grand mean u_bar; shrink u_hat_i^JS = u_bar + (1-B)(u_hat_i - u_bar) where B is estimated by empirical Bayes from comparison-graph topology. Source refuses to invent a scalar B.

key.name: Network exposure mapping
key.steps: 1) neighbor_treatment_counts = A @ treatment_vector. 2) degree = np.sum(A, axis=1); degree[degree == 0] = 1.0. 3) exposure_ratio = neighbor_treatment_counts/degree. 4) for each i: state 1 if treatment[i]==1; elif exposure_ratio[i] >= threshold: state 2; else 0. Test: 3-node path graph 0-1-2, treatment [1,0,0] -> exposure [1, 2, 0].

key.name: SPI — Synthetic-powered predictive inference (Bashari, Maor Lotan, Lee, Dobriban, Romano 2025; arXiv:2505.13432)

key.name: Neyman Jackknife variance
key.steps: 1) base_ate = horvitz_thompson_estimator(outcomes, treatment, propensities). 2) for i in range(n): delete index i from outcomes/treatment/propensities; recompute sub_ht = sum(out_i[treat_i==1]/prop_i[treat_i==1])/(n-1) - sum(out_i[treat_i==0]/(1-prop_i[treat_i==0]))/(n-1); append. 3) variance = ((n-1)/n)*sum((jackknife_ates - base_ate)**2).

key.name: DistMatch — adaptive binning via distribution matching for sequential CP (Menadjiev et al., ICML 2026; arXiv:2606.00690)
key.steps: Targets settings where residual exchangeability is violated by temporal dependencies and distributional shifts. Approximates exchangeability through reweighting, using adaptive binning via distribution matching. (Mechanism details beyond this are not within read scope.)

key.name: In-game decision engine (4th down, two-point, clock)

key.name: Rolling-origin conformal prediction under local stationarity and weak dependence (Halkiewicz 2026; arXiv:2605.08422)
key.steps: Calibrate the conformal quantile against the m most recent pseudo-out-of-sample forecast errors; adapts to serial dependence, volatility clustering, and distributional drift. Designed for local stationarity (distribution changes slowly over time) and weak dependence (correlations decay).

key.name: Split-conformal calibration protocol
key.steps: Fit model on training split; compute non-conformity scores on a held-out calibration split; sort ascending; take the ceil((n+1)(1-alpha))-th order statistic as q_hat; publish interval mu_hat +/- q_hat. Fail closed (infinite interval / abstain) if n < ceil(1/alpha) - 1; never clamp the index.

key.name: Split-conformal floor baseline for time-series forecasting (Manokhin 2026; arXiv:2606.09473)
key.steps: The simplest possible conformal interval — a last-value point forecast wrapped in a finite-sample split-conformal interval — proposed as a mandatory baseline for probabilistic time-series forecasting, because learned probabilistic forecasters are often compared against weak or omitted baselines. (Fragment truncated in source.)

key.name: Copula dependence engine (Frank) + Frechet-Hoeffding gate
key.steps: Estimate theta by MLE (or IFM: fit marginals first, then theta) maximising sum ln c_theta(F1(x_i),F2(y_i)); evaluate C_theta; enforce max(0,u+v-1) <= C <= min(u,v) with 1e-6 tolerance (violation => c_i=0, trajectory discarded); verify reported joint probability against C_theta(p_A,p_B) within eps=0.005; fall back to independence when |theta| < 1e-9.

key.name: correlated_update damping from measured copula matrix
key.steps: Read rho for the pair from docs/props/research/2026-10-13/sgp_correlations.json (1,088 team-games); derive damping weight √ρ (example √0.6995=0.8363); apply damped LR = LR^(√ρ) (example 1.2320^0.8363 = 1.1906); cite the matrix cell in the step output; pairs outside the matrix fall back to the heuristic and are 'logged as a named gap, never silently'.

key.name: CQR interval construction (pinball-loss quantile nets)
key.steps: Train lower/upper quantile regressors with the asymmetric pinball loss at alpha_lo=alpha/2 and alpha_hi=1-alpha/2; score calibration set with E_i=max(q_lo(X_i)-Y_i, Y_i-q_hi(X_i)); take Q_{1-alpha} = ceil((1-alpha)(|I_2|+1))-th largest E_i; output [q_lo(X)-Q, q_hi(X)+Q]. Invalid for binary moneyline outcomes.

key.name: GRPO training loop (critic-free) with verifier error correction
key.steps: Sample a group of G trajectories per prompt; compute rewards R(y_i); form A_i=(R-median)/(MAD+eps); apply backward correction R_hat=(R_obs-rho_0)/(1-rho_0-rho_1) (fail closed to zeros if rho_0+rho_1>=1); optimise clipped surrogate with KL-to-reference penalty beta*D_KL; PRM gates each step with multiplicative Bellman Q-decay product of step validities.

key.name: Forensic audit / Lost-and-Found reconciliation

key.name: Adversarial breaking-conditions protocol
key.steps: Every thesis pre-registers breaking conditions BEFORE the game; if any condition triggers pre-game, the play is dropped; if partially met, note it; post-game audit which conditions fired and what was missed. MNF applied: stafford_sack_count > 3 (expected 1.0 — not met), nacua_target_share < 22% (expected 34% — not met), wind > 15 mph (dome, N/A), pace < 28 sec/play (projected 25.2 — not met).

key.name: BFQR — Binned Fair Quantile Regression with conformal calibration (Wang et al. 2023, NeurIPS; arXiv:2311.02243)
key.steps: For Equal Opportunity of Coverage (EOC — two properties: coverage rates for different groups with similar outcomes are close; population coverage remains at a predetermined level): calibrate a hold-out set to bound deviation from EOC, then leverage conformal prediction to maintain EOC on a test set while optimizing prediction interval width.

key.name: Venn-Abers binary calibration via dual PAVA isotonic regressions
key.steps: 1) Pre-coalesce tied raw scores; 2) fit dual monotonic isotonic regressions to calibration set augmented with hypothetical test labels (X_{n+1},0) and (X_{n+1},1) using Pool Adjacent Violators; 3) output multiprobability bounds [p0,p1]; 4) compute width Delta_p = p1-p0; 5) fail closed (No-Bet) if Delta_p > 0.20; bounds feed robust Kelly worst-case sizing.

key.name: Bradley-Terry Zermelo MM iteration with gauge fixing
key.steps: Initialise pi_i=1; compute W_i=sum_j w_ij; update pi_i^{(t+1)}=W_i / sum_{j!=i} (w_ij+w_ji)/(pi_i+pi_j) simultaneously; renormalise by the geometric mean after each sweep; iterate to convergence. Fail closed if any W_i=0 (winless node) or the denominator is 0; existence requires every partition of the entity set to have at least one cross-win.

key.name: GSE UQ validation gate (pre-display)
key.steps: 1) Build candidate UQ output on settled pick-level rows with covariates (modelVersion, market, bin) at weekly grain; 2) refresh alpha/bins weekly (adaptive family: ACI / SPCI / PID-style), replacing static Mondrian q-hats only 'IF coverage holds walk-forward'; 3) candidate must beat Mondrian static bins on the 2025 replay at equal coverage; 4) display change only if the gate passes; floors stay unchanged without founder approval.

key.name: Line-movement / sharp-money detection
key.steps: Model dL/dt = alpha*sharp + beta*public + gamma*news + delta*mean-reversion (alpha>beta); flag Steam = I(dL/dt>theta_L and dV/dt>theta_V); flag RLM = I(sign(dL) != sign(P_public-0.5)); fit a per-side exponential-decay Hawkes process with online intensity updates to separate background volatility from clustered informed pressure (hawkes-steam.ts).

key.name: PRM / verifier pipeline (expert system)
key.steps: Bridge model converts 47 registered signals -> directional P(outcome) with n and homeSign; reasoning traces scored step-wise by PRM with multiplicative Bellman Q-decay; noisy verifier corrected backward (R_backward) or forward; copula for asymmetric tail dependence; split conformal calibration; Murphy partition with fail-closed halt if Reliability>Resolution.

key.name: RLCP — Randomly Localized Conformal Prediction (Conrad et al. 2026; arXiv:2608.06206)
key.steps: Randomly localize the conformal prediction around the test point, trading off between marginal and conditional coverage; provides finite-sample guarantees and characterizes how close one can get to conditional coverage, given that 'exact distribution-free conditional coverage is finite-sample unattainable' and that 'marginal validity can hide severe covariate-specific miscalibration'.

key.name: JamesSteinShrinkageEngine.classic_james_stein
key.steps: 1) y = np.asarray(y, dtype float64). 2) p = y.shape[0]; raise ValueError('James-Stein estimation requires dimension p >= 3.') if p < 3. 3) mu = np.mean(y) if target_mean is None else target_mean. 4) diff = y - mu. 5) norm_sq = np.sum(diff**2). 6) shrinkage_factor = max(0.0, 1.0 - ((p - 2)*sigma_sq)/max(norm_sq, 1e-12)). 7) theta_hat = mu + shrinkage_factor*diff. 8) return (theta_hat, shrinkage_factor).

key.name: Dixon-Coles with time decay (coordinate MLE)
key.steps: weight_i = exp(-xi*days_from_max); iterate: attack update t via weighted MLE (log(num/den) clipped +-4), defense updates (no mu at home, with mu away), home advantage mu=log(num/den) clipped +-2, center attack; xi grid (0.0,0.002,0.005,0.01) x rho grid (-0.08,-0.05,-0.02,0.0); score by decay-normalized weighted loglik/match; evaluate held-out season vs Pinnacle closing (log-loss).

key.name: Factorized spatio-temporal transformer for trajectories
key.steps: 1) Temporal self-attention block models each player's trajectory independently across T (O(N*T^2)); 2) equivariant spatial cross-attention computes multi-agent interaction at each timestep across N agents (O(T*N^2)); 3) continuous spatial bias tensor B_rel(i,j)=phi(p_i - p_j, ||p_i - p_j||_2) injects geometry into attention logits; 4) total O(N*T^2 + T*N^2), strict causal in time, agent-permutation equivariant.

key.name: ESOE route-evaluation pipeline
key.steps: 1) Fit cubic B-spline to raw 10Hz receiver trajectory (Cox-de Boor) for exact derivatives; 2) segment into 3 kinematic phases (stem / break / arrival) using curvature global max above threshold + deceleration dip; 3) train gradient-boosted quantile regressor for E[S(t_arrival)|RouteClass, CoverageScheme, leverage at break, v_rec at break, throw-to-break time]; 4) residual ESOE = S(t_arrival) - E[S(t_arrival)] isolates route-running precision.

key.name: Two-mode IMM filter (sprint / cut) with 3D ballistic ball track
key.steps: 1) Mode 1 M_sprint: low-noise constant-velocity filter; 2) Mode 2 M_cut: Singer constant-acceleration/turn model with high Q_cut; 3) Each frame update mode probabilities mu_k(m) proportional to mu_{k|k-1}(m)*N(y_k^{(m)};0,S_k^{(m)}) from innovation likelihoods; 4) Ball uses separate 6-state [x,y,z,vx,vy,vz]^T ballistic filter with -g along z and Q_ball >> Q_player for landing conditioning.

Sole writers: PID 29392 -> brain/mind.jsonl, PID 23736 -> brain/mind_budget.jsonl.

key.name: Hartley Normalized DLT homography estimation
key.steps: 1) Collect N>=4 pixel<->field landmark correspondences (no three collinear); 2) precondition both sets with isotropic similarity transforms T_img, T_field (translate centroid to origin, scale mean distance to sqrt(2)); 3) build 2N x 9 design matrix A (2 rows per point from x_i x H u_i = 0); 4) SVD, take right singular vector with smallest singular value as h under ||h||=1; 5) denormalize H = T_field^{-1} H' T_img.

key.name: AdaptiveKalman with Joseph-form update + torso-confidence weighting
key.steps: 1) 4-state [x,y,vx,vy]^T predict with F and Q_k; 2) compute y_k = z_k - H_obs x_hat, S_k = H_obs P H_obs^T + R_k, K_k = P H_obs^T S_k^{-1}; 3) Joseph-form covariance update for numerical symmetry/PD; 4) R_k built from mean torso keypoint confidence c_bar_torso,k and Jacobian-propagated pixel covariance; 5) Q_k adapts to estimated acceleration magnitude (Q_k = Q_base*(1+0.5*max(0,||a||-2.0))).

key.name: Robust Bayes superstar protection
key.steps: 1) mu = np.mean(y); diff = y - mu; std_dev = np.std(y). 2) baseline_hat = classic_james_stein(y, target_mean=mu). 3) z_scores = abs(diff)/max(std_dev, 1e-12). 4) protection_weights = np.where(z_scores > outlier_threshold_std, 1.0 - np.exp(-0.5*(z_scores - outlier_threshold_std)**2), 0.0). 5) theta_robust = (1 - protection_weights)*baseline_hat + protection_weights*y. Unit test asserts the extreme outlier (12.0 among ~0.1-scale values) retains larger magnitude than classic JS.

key.name: TVCalib differentiable segment registration
key.steps: 1) Model each visible yard stripe/hash line as 3D parametric segment discretized into Npc*=128 dense points; 2) optimize point-to-polyline distances over batched tensors via AdamW (lr=0.05, weight decay 0.01, 2,000 steps, one-cycle schedule pct_start=0.5); 3) directly recover phi={FoV,t,pan,tilt,roll} and psi={k1,k2} from yard-line curvature in one step (used as fallback for tight zooms with <4 visible intersections).

key.name: Market moneyline calibration backtest (the baseline to beat)
key.steps: Corpus 5,281 settled NFL games 2006–2025; take closing moneyline; de-vig proportionally; exclude ties; hold out 2016–2025 (n=2,750). Build a reliability curve mapping predicted home-win probability → observed home-win %; compute Brier, ECE (equal-width AND adaptive bins), and Murphy terms; compare calibrators (isotonic, Platt, beta) against the identity by mean held-out Δ across 10 walk-forward folds (docs/data/MARKET_CALIBRATION_2026-09-04.md:7-12,34-61)

key.name: Pre-estimation integrity assertions (fail-fast gates)
key.steps: (1) Join Integrity Check: historical closing spread merges must match exactly n = 3,368 decisive games, aborting if missing records skew the training sample. (2) Slate Dummy Non-Zero Check: time-window binary flags (SNF, TNF) must have non-zero positive sums to catch date-only string formatting bugs. (3) Distributional Parameter Type Check: reported uncertainty ranges must be genuine posterior draw percentiles (2.5% to 97.5%), never standard errors divided by \sqrt{n}.

key.name: Monte-Carlo Student-t copula SGP pricing
key.steps: Take the empirical 8×8 nflverse correlation matrix (1,088 games); run 50,000 draws of a Student-t copula with ν = 4.0; compute joint P for the bundle (4-leg example 20.41%; 2-leg example 39.25%); compute the naive independent product as book model (4-leg 9.80%; 2-leg 30.98%); report lift (20.41/9.80 → +108.2%; 39.25/30.98 → +26.68%) and z (58.85 / 37.85); price legs: Stafford Over 260.5 pass yds, Stafford Over 1.5 pass TDs, Nacua Over 93.5 rec yds, Allen Over 245.5 pass yds.

key.name: pricesWorseThanMarket hard PASS veto (packages/prediction-engine/src/index.ts:145)
key.steps: Verbatim: 'export function pricesWorseThanMarket(edge: IndependentEdgeSummary | null): boolean { if (!edge) return false; if (edge.decision === "PASS") return true; // <-- HARD VETO: Must drop all PASS decisions; if (!Number.isFinite(edge.expectedClv)) return false; return edge.expectedClv < 0; }' — ensures no pick where the model says PASS can slip through at confidence 50. P0 action: 'Seal the PASS Veto Leak'; verify no PASS decision slips through.

key.name: Stratified field-zone evaluation protocol
key.steps: 1) Compute Mahalanobis residual e_k = z_k,NGS - H_obs x_hat against P_{k|k}^{(xy)}; 2) test e_k^T (P^{(xy)})^{-1} e_k <= 4.60517 for 90% joint 2D coverage; 3) partition coverage and RMSE into 4 mutually exclusive zones: Zone 1 Near Sideline (10<=X<=110 yd, 0<=Y<17.78 yd), Zone 2 Mid-Field (17.78<=Y<=35.55 yd), Zone 3 Far Sideline (35.55<Y<=53.33 yd), Zone 4 End-Zone (X in [0,10) or (110,120] yd); 4) require [0.85,0.95] in every zone.

key.name: Idle-period (bye-week) processing rule
key.steps: For a team with no contest in the active rating period: leave rating \mu and volatility \sigma unchanged and expand uncertainty only: \phi' = \sqrt{\phi^2 + \sigma^2}, WITHOUT solving for updated volatility. Reference expansion for RD = 200.0, \sigma = 0.06: 1 week 200.2714, 4 weeks 201.0835, 17 weeks 204.5651. NOTE: 'The implementation in ratings2.py fails to execute this step because it only iterates over teams present in the active period's game records, leaving idle teams unadjusted.'

key.name: 27-season frozen-model replay harness (1999–2025)
key.steps: Run the frozen model over 1999–2025 spreads/totals with synthetic −110 pricing; grade picks W/L/P; require CLV = MATCHED_CLOSE for every pick; count lookahead errors (measured 0); then compute headline win rate + 95% CI vs break-even at −110, ROI by market, win-rate/ROI by confidence stratum, and AUC with a permutation test for discrimination (docs/data/NFL_REPLAY_CALIBRATION_2026-09-04.md:16-25,56-64,79-94,153-159; docs/data/CONVERGENT_CALIBRATION_EVIDENCE_2026-09-04.md:15,27)

key.name: 4-DoF orthogonal vanishing-point constrained homography
key.steps: 1) Detect line segments per frame (Hough/LSD); 2) estimate transverse vanishing point vx from yard lines (world direction dx=[0,1,0]) and longitudinal vanishing point vy from sidelines/number baselines/hash corridors (dy=[1,0,0]) via J-Linkage or RANSAC; 3) lock horizon l_inf = vx x vy, fixing first two columns of M=H^{-1} as m1=lambda1*vy, m2=lambda2*vx; 4) solve remaining 4 unknowns (lambda1, lambda2, m13, m23); 5) H = M^{-1}.

key.name: Fail-closed conformal execution sequence (split CQR)
key.steps: 1) Base models output lower/upper quantiles via pinball loss; 2) compute calibration non-conformity scores E_i; 3) compute rank index k=ceil((n+1)(1-alpha)); 4) if k<=n extract Q_{1-alpha}=E_(k) and apply symmetrically; 5) if k>n the sample is insufficient -> emit infinite interval [-inf,+inf] or automated No-Bet block (clamping banned in cqr.ts); 6) scarce segments (n<ceil(1/alpha)-1) substitute Jackknife+ with LOO residuals reporting the true 1-2*alpha bound.

key.name: Seven-rung pricing methodology
key.steps: 1) books PRICE not predict (Pinnacle opens from power ratings); 2) sharp money -> steam -> retail follows (edge window = lag); 3) watch Pinnacle-vs-retail divergence, reverse line movement, closing line as truth; 4) engine ladder: power ratings -> Bayesian updating -> Monte Carlo -> devigged market baseline (must beat) -> ML -> ensembles; 5) calibration = measured by Brier/log loss; 6) fractional Kelly sizing; 7) data: Pinnacle guest API, ESPN feed, Sleeper API, The Odds API.

key.name: Stadium weather / air-density pilot (Open-Meteo)
key.steps: VENUES as (venue, city) pairs (8 stadiums); for each: geocode CITY via geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search (params name, count=1, language, format) → lat/lon; pull 4-day hourly forecast from Open-Meteo; compute air density ρ per venue; record venue + geocode_query + method note 'city-level coordinates (stadium building not indexed)'. Initial failure mode: geocoding stadium NAMES returned empty ('geocode miss') — fixed by city names. Output: docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-13/weather-pilot/.

key.name: TQA — Conformal Prediction with Temporal Quantile Adjustments (Lin, Trivedi, Sun 2022; arXiv:2205.09940)
key.steps: Post-hoc wrapper around any time-series regression model for regression on cross-sectional time-series data. Unlike standard CP, which queries a pre-specified quantile from the calibration scores, TQA adjusts the quantile to query at each time t, accounting for both cross-sectional coverage (across a population at a fixed time) and longitudinal coverage (along time for each series). Improves longitudinal coverage while preserving cross-sectional coverage.

key.name: Deduplication ladder (normalise -> exact -> near-dup -> semantic)
key.steps: Normalise (byte-decode to Unicode, fold \r\n to \n; never strip inline TeX comments, macro definitions or exponents); exact SHA-256 to collapse worktree copies; MinHash/SimHash candidate generation with LSH banding; withhold merge when MinHash and SimHash disagree; hash math spans only after syntax validation; dense embeddings only re-rank pre-filtered clusters. Space is indexed 'hash then near-dup', not a flat file count.

key.name: Self-organized / group-conditional conformal calibration (Berthier et al. 2026; arXiv:2606.29403)
key.steps: Address regional coverage gaps from a single pooled calibration set: discover groups in an unsupervised manner, then calibrate conformal prediction separately for each group. Related within-scope variants: Mondrian group-conditional conformal prediction (arXiv:2608.07589); group conformalized quantile regression integrating domain expert insights (arXiv:2408.08637); group-conditional CP via quantile regression calibration for crop/weed classification (arXiv:2308.15094).

key.name: Content-hash dedupe (intended invariant, currently broken)
key.steps: Hash each ingested file (sha256); check .mind_guardian/ledger.json for the hash; skip duplicates; feed rows carry schema {sha256, text, path, bucket, source}; W1: reconcile .mind_guardian/ledger.json against today's trainer feed (python one-shot) and measure the 0-overlap break between 117 ledger hashes and 722 feed hashes; W2: stream-dedupe brain/feeds/2026-10-13/trainer_feed.jsonl (231 MB, 3,842 rows → ~722 distinct), ~5× reduction, no OOM, original preserved until a consumer is repointed.

key.name: PlayGen-MoG trajectory forecasting (tracking models as features)
key.steps: 1) Condition on static pre-snap formation F and role identifiers r; 2) non-autoregressive parallel output of K multimodal Gaussian mixture components across all T timesteps simultaneously (no sequential displacement accumulation -> no compounding drift); 3) mixture weights pi_k shared across all 22 agents to enforce globally coordinated tactical scenarios and prevent mode collapse; 4) dispersion priors must be constrained to avoid component entropy collapse.

key.name: Fine-tuning execution ladder with kill rules
key.steps: Phase 1 Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B (1 epoch, packed batch 8, suffix gse_probe) vs held-out NFL season + disjoint arXiv set; if log loss or Brier fail to beat untuned base, abort and retain $26.00. Phase 2 Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (LoRA batch 2, no adapter merge) only if Phase 1 wins holdout; abort and retain $21.00 on failure. Phase 3 deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (batch 1, $27.00, $3.00 reserve) only if Phases 1-2 succeed and verified reasoning traces exist on disk.

key.name: YTG fourth-down conversion matrix (commit 9633e4e4e)
key.steps: 1) Take all 3,464 fourth-down go plays in the pre-2026 Week 4 corpus. 2) Compute conversion rates in YTG bins (1, 2, 3, 4-6, 7-10, 11+ yards). 3) Build 57-cell Field Position x YTG matrix. 4) Keep cells with n >= 40 plays (29 cleared); all other cells raise explicit DataGapError abstention (no un-grounded row-level backfilling). 5) Net benefit computed from cell conversion vs kick option (e.g. opp 40-yd line, 1 yd: 0.684, n=196, net +1.271 vs +0.276 under flat league rate); model weight withheld.

key.name: Corrected CEPT ensemble design (5 steps)
key.steps: Base models output different units of analysis and cannot be multiplicatively combined: (1) common target across base models; (2) meta-model / stacked generalization (e.g. logistic regression on base-model outputs + game-state features); (3) Bayesian model averaging for expert weights weighted by posterior probability, not fixed weights; (4) conformal calibration layer on the meta-model output using a sliding window (data sequential, not exchangeable); (5) rank-clustered BTL as sparse-data fallback.

key.name: stored-signal-env-bridge (silent weather-leak fix)
key.steps: generate-signal-slate (prod cron, every 15 min) passed bare process.env to the signal registry while game-weather-capture writes weather to the DB, not env → wind-elasticity and the continuous-tilt path computed from an empty env (silently null for months). Fix: stored-signal-env-bridge.ts injects DB weather into the slate env — DB-first, explicit env overrides win, fail-open — plus a PRECIP_IN alias so the temp/precip decay signal can fire; two DARK signals promoted to SHADOW_ONLY pending founder promotion.

key.name: Run-blocking classification and RYOE isolation
key.steps: 1) 11-player spatio-temporal transformer processes first 1.5 s post-snap to classify 7 run concepts (Duo, Outside Zone, Inside Zone, Pin-Pull, Counter, Trap, Split Zone) from OL displacement vectors Delta_P_OL in R^{5x2} and velocity divergence; 2) detect pulling linemen via I_pull(i); 3) bipartite blocker-defender matching via Engagement_ij(t) proximity+momentum criterion; 4) compute RYOE = Y_actual - E[Y | RunScheme, p_carrier(t_handoff), v_carrier(t_handoff), {B_ij(t_handoff)}_{i=1..5}].

key.name: Execution safeguards / human control gates
key.steps: Commits restricted to research branches; merging to main (e1260ae) requires manual PR review and human sign-off. No outbound network connections to payment gateways (Stripe), banking rails, or automated wager-placement APIs. The runner records closing-line residuals, Brier scores and calibration intervals internally and is blocked from publishing public betting recommendations or automated picks. Production parameters (NFL_EPA_HFA = 0.025 EPA/play; 10 mph wind threshold) cannot be modified by the automated estimation loop.

key.name: Jacobian covariance-propagation control (Rung 1 / Step 1)
key.steps: 1) For each detected keypoint (u_k,v_k) compute 2x2 Jacobian J(u_k,v_k) from the current homography H; 2) form R_pixel = (1/max(conf,0.05)) diag(sigma_u^2, sigma_v^2); 3) propagate R_field = J R_pixel J^T + epsilon*I2, epsilon=10^-6 m^2; 4) inject R_field into AdaptiveKalman.update() replacing scalar isotropic R; 5) re-run all 787 highlight plays and publish stratified 4-zone coverage/RMSE table to isolate pure covariance-propagation effect vs point bias.

key.name: Glicko-2 full rating update (8 steps)
key.steps: 1) mu=(r-1500)/173.7178, phi=RD/173.7178; 2) g(phi)=1/sqrt(1+3phi^2/pi^2); 3) E=1/(1+exp(-g(phi_j)(mu-mu_j))); 4) v=[sum g^2 E(1-E)]^-1; 5) Delta=v*sum g(phi_j)(s_j-E); 6) Illinois root search on f(x) for sigma' (tol 1e-6, 100 steps); 7) phi'=1/sqrt(1/(phi^2+sigma'^2)+1/v); 8) r'=173.7178 mu'+1500, RD'=173.7178 phi'. Inactivity branch retains mu and inflates phi. Pre-scale 1/173.7178 alone is not the inverse of the scale-back, so skipping the volatility step invalidates the chain.

key.name: Calibration seam fail-closed wrapper
key.steps: 1) Thread EdgeInput.calibrator into context.probabilityCalibrator. 2) Evaluate probability adjustment before edge calculation. 3) If calibrator throws, returns non-finite numbers, or parameters missing: refuse transformation, fall back to uncalibrated raw probability. 4) All downstream sizing, confidence scoring, and withholding consume the seam output. 5) Two call sites in scoring.ts must both pass the calibrator (measured: scoring.ts:678 and :1325 both pass input.context.probabilityCalibrator).

key.name: Rating systems suite (8, reimplement-ready)
key.steps: Colley C r=b (C_ii=2+n_i, C_ij=-n_ij, b_i=1+(w_i-l_i)/2); Massey ridge least squares on point margin; SRS fixed-point Gauss-Seidel damp=0.7 100 iters; PageRank beat-graph (edges loser->winner, weight 1+|margin|/10, d=0.85); Keener skew matrix column-normalized power iteration x=1.0; Glicko-2 period-parallel update with Illinois volatility iteration (scale 173.7178, tau=0.5); TrueSkill pairwise analytic (beta=25/6); Plackett-Luce MM. ensemble_margin = mean of systems' implied margins + spread_of_views.

NOTE: self-audit found chain links 2–5 are a templated sentence with names swapped and the Bayesian layer uses only air-density + wind (42 NGS facts + 19 injuries contribute nothing) — see blockers.

key.name: GSE-X reasoning cycle with epistemic refusal gate
key.steps: 1) Fuse 5 domain signal vectors via concatenate; compute mean_edge_signal, signal_dispersion, epistemic_confidence. 2) If epistemic_gate_strict and epistemic_confidence < confidence_threshold (0.75): return status ABSTAIN with reason 'Epistemic uncertainty exceeds safety threshold. High cross-domain signal dispersion.' 3) Else final_signal = raw_edge_signal; if counterfactual_do is not None: final_signal = base_state + do_intervention_delta*causal_weight. 4) Return status EXECUTE with evaluated_edge and epistemic_confidence.

key.name: Selective publication gate (conformal risk control on top of the close)
key.steps: 1) Input: engine p and de-vigged close on sealed games. 2) Output: lambda_hat and publish/shadow bit. 3) Loss = Brier or log loss of posted picks only. 4) Test: expected posted-pick loss <= alpha on a sealed season not used to pick lambda; shuffled-time placebo must not pass. 5) Bar: posted set beats the close on log loss, and the abstained set is where the engine was worse. Status: shadow (sources: c05-map citing ledger 0743 and MARKET_CALIBRATION_2026-09-04.md; phase2-search-notes-calibration.md CQR/selective regression).

key.steps: Compute metrics on the public-performance population (published, non-bootstrap, not v5.0.0-seed). GREEN requires BOTH (a) all floors met: n>=100, brier<=0.22, ece<=0.05, murphyReliability<=0.05; AND (b) consecutiveGreen >= streakRequired (default 3). Since C-275 the deployed model version must clear the ECE floor on its OWN rows, not only in a pooled sample whose strata cancel. C-290/C-292: read the bias-corrected ECE; C-298: read the slice's 5th-percentile bootstrap bound (apps/web/lib/ops/calibration-eligibility.ts:152-288, :66-72, :203-256)

key.steps: 1) Source Identification (deterministic pipeline: nflverse, FTN, live odds feeds, scrapers). 2) End-to-End Wiring (normalize payloads into structured TS types, intake -> scoring -> reasoning). 3) Backtested Weighting (zero-centered walk-forward coefficients vs historical seasons using closing line offsets). 4) Unit & Integration Testing (activation, edge cases, missing-data behavior, post-freeze immutability). 5) Reasoning Trace Integration (show exact numerical + qualitative impact in a generated pick trace). Every signal must reach all five (Law 5).

key.steps: At process startup both generate-signal-slate.ts and board-fill.ts call validateEmissionEligibility(manifestPath): throws CRITICAL_GATE_MISSING if manifest absent; returns eligible=false on GALAXY_LOCKED_STATE_VIOLATION (mu!=market_close or vision_weight!=0.0 or zero_imputation!=true or pass_veto!=unconditional) or GATE_NOT_CLEARED (passed=false OR effectiveCrps>7.099 OR n<150). buildZeroSlateObject emits {picks:[],parlays:[],dfs_lineups:[],gate_status:'LOCKED_ZERO_OBJECT'}. No DB write on trip.

key.name: L-STN relative-offset encoding + temporal pose filtering
key.steps: 1) Encode local geometry as pairwise relative offsets between neighboring grid keypoints instead of absolute pixel coordinates (bias-resistant under scrum occlusion); 2) long-range self-attention aligns distant unoccluded pixels on the same rigid yard line (L_total = lambda_offset*L_offset + lambda_pose*L_pose); 3) filter image-space keypoint trajectories with a linear Kalman filter and Savitzky-Golay smoothing before non-linear pose refinement; reported JaC@5deg 78.2% vs PnLCalib baseline 76.7%.

key.name: Root-solver bake-off on the canonical test vector
key.steps: Evaluate Illinois (Glickman published: 2 iterations), Plain Regula Falsi (2), Newton-Raphson (2), Bisection (19) with inputs \phi = 1.151292, v = 1.778977, \Delta = -0.483933, a = -5.626821, \tau = 0.5; all four converge to x = -5.626955 and \sigma' = exp(x/2) = 0.059996. Failure modes: Illinois stalls on an exact zero root without strict threshold checks; plain regula falsi stalls on asymmetric convex asymptotes when \Delta^2 >> \phi^2 + v; Newton-Raphson diverges on flat asymptotic plateaus as x -> ±infinity; bisection is unconditionally stable but slow.

key.name: Pick sealing / proof-receipt convention
key.steps: Before kickoff, each published pick with a full market quote is frozen into a receipt: the side, the line, the price, the scores claimed, and the moment it was frozen, all stamped with a SHA-256 hash. The receipt is never rewritten. The server re-computes the hash from the stored record live on /verify; a pick without a receipt carries no verified claim ('we don't grade what we didn't seal'). Before game start receipts verify as sealed, fields open automatically once the game begins (app/verify page copy; app/verify/page.tsx:34-50; scope rule lib/picks/market-implied-display.ts:12-20,86-90)

key.name: Multi-view triangulation + information-matrix fusion benchmark
key.steps: 1) On BDB/NGS plays with synchronized Broadcast/All-22 sideline (c=1) and end-zone (c=2) views, per-view project detections with calibrated P1=K1[R1|t1], P2=K2[R2|t2]; 2) solve two-view DLT system A X~ = 0 via SVD (cv2.triangulatePoints), optionally midpoint-refine; 3) fuse Jacobian-propagated field covariances in information form R_fused = (R1^{-1}+R2^{-1})^{-1}; 4) compare single-view RMSE/90% coverage in Zone 3 and Zone 4 against R_fused to quantify the exact precision delta of a second camera angle.

key.name: SEMF — Supervised Expectation-Maximization Framework (Azizi, Boldi, Chavez-Demoulin 2024; arXiv:2405.18176)
key.steps: Model-agnostic framework for complete or missing data; extends EM to a supervised context by treating the prediction target as a latent variable: (E-step) estimate the posterior distribution of the latent target given observed data and current model parameters; (M-step) update model parameters to maximize the expected complete-data likelihood; implemented via Monte Carlo sampling (similar to variational inference in VAEs). Produces point estimates and prediction intervals with any ML model (gradient-boosted trees, neural networks).

key.name: OpenCV Multiplane Iterative Voter selection rule
key.steps: 1) Evaluate candidate calibrations across 4 point subsets: all detected keypoints (3-plane when goalposts visible), line-line intersection keypoints Kp only, RANSAC-filtered ground-plane keypoints at 5 px homography reprojection tolerance, and all ground-plane keypoints; 2) repeat across 3 Optuna-tuned confidence thresholds; 3) score each candidate by pitch-pattern reprojection RMSE; 4) prefer full-point fit when reprojection RMSE < 5 px, else fall back to lowest-RMSE subset (fail-closed per-frame calibration ensemble).

key.name: Adaptive conformal prediction by reweighting nonconformity scores (Amoukou & Brunel 2023; arXiv:2303.12695)
key.steps: Use a Quantile Regression Forest (QRF) to learn the distribution of nonconformity scores and to assign weights to calibration points: w_i = ρ(x_i, x_{n+1}) / (1/n ∑j ρ(x_j, x{n+1})) with ρ a similarity measure — greater weight to calibration points closer to the test sample, lower to farther ones. Take the weighted empirical quantile of nonconformity scores → interval adapts to the local difficulty of each test point (a single global threshold can be too wide for easy points and too narrow for difficult ones).

key.name: iWinRNFL rating fit + dynamic multi-week loader
key.steps: 1) Least-squares fit of Expected Home Margin = Home Edge + Home Rating - Away Rating with identification constraint sum(Rating_i) = 0, coefficients standardized. 2) Fit on finished games prior to target week (1,187 NFL games for the base fit; home edge 2.178). 3) Dynamic loader (commit 1758cfa0d) constructs rating equations for any historical/current week using finished games verified via 'END GAME' markers in play-by-play. 4) Convert margins to probabilities via Phi(margin/14), sd fixed unfitted. 5) Frozen Week 4 verification: PIT@CLE -0.956 across 1,187 completed games.

key.name: Kalshi NFL open-market ingest
key.steps: 1) GET /trade-api/v2/series/?category=Sports (needs -L / redirect follow). 2) Filter tickers containing 'NFL' AND any token in (GAME, WEEK, SPREAD, TOTAL, MWIN, WIN); sort so GAME tickers first; cap to 6 series. 3) Per series: GET /markets/?series_ticker=<t>&status=open&limit=200. 4) Extract per market: ticker, event_ticker, title, yes_sub_title, yes_bid, yes_ask, last_price, volume, open_interest, close_time — with API-drift mapping from *_dollars string fields (yes_bid_dollars etc.) and *_fp fields. 5) Land digest JSON + MD (prices as 0-100 probabilities). Per-series errors recorded honestly, never invented.

key.steps: 1) Signal Ingestion (EPA facets, line match-ups, weather, rest/travel, coaching tendencies). 2) Point-In-Time Freeze (features locked at dataFreshnessAt / official pre-kickoff). 3) Zero-Centered Re-Weighting (offline walk-forward vs closing market offsets; internal detail vague). 4) Uncalibrated Edge Assessment (edge-engine.ts / scoring.ts). 5) Calibration Seam Evaluation (probabilityCalibrator, fail-closed fallback). 6) Explicit Reasoning Trace Generation (active/inactive contributions + audit rationale). 7) Decision & Execution (Book A immutable published; Book B shadow rescore).

key.name: Glicko-2 volatility root solve (Illinois / regula falsi with explicit zero-root guard)
key.steps: Solve f(x) = e^x(\Delta^2 - \phi^2 - v - e^x)/(2(\phi^2+v+e^x)^2) - (x-a)/\tau^2 = 0 by bracket [A,B] with A = a (start at log sigma) and B = a - k\tau stepping while \Delta^2 <= \phi^2 + v until f(a-k\tau) >= 0; chord iteration C = A + (A-B) f_A/(f_B - f_A); on exact root f(C)=0 the strict test f(C)f(B) < 0 is false, so the else branch halves f_A and sets B <- C, which stalls |B-A| and can loop forever -> 'The production implementation must enforce an explicit check: if abs(f_c) < 1e-12: return math.exp(C / 2.0).' Terminate on |B - A| < 1e-6.

key.name: wf_situational_engine walk-forward harness (reimplement-ready)
key.steps: 1) Sort games by (season, week). 2) For each week W: fit beta by grid search over [-0.25,0.50] (151 pts) minimizing mean Gaussian CRPS strictly on prior weeks with non-null feature; require >=25 valid else beta=0. 3) Score week with beta_W then append week to prior pool (strict (<W) isolation). 4) Metric status = ACCEPTED_CANDIDATE if delta<0 else REFUSED (Stop Condition A, no retune). 5) Gate: passed = n>=150 AND mean CRPS<=7.099 AND delta<0; else emission locked at 0-object. CVI raises RuntimeError (terminal refusal).

key.name: PASS veto — pricesWorseThanMarket (P0, 'HARD VETO')
key.steps: TypeScript at packages/prediction-engine/src/index.ts:145. Exact code: export function pricesWorseThanMarket(edge: IndependentEdgeSummary | null): boolean { if (!edge) return false; if (edge.decision === "PASS") return true; /* HARD VETO: Must drop all PASS decisions */ if (!Number.isFinite(edge.expectedClv)) return false; return edge.expectedClv < 0; }. Semantics: null edge → false (not worse); decision PASS → true (withhold); non-finite expectedClv → false; negative expectedClv → true (withhold). Verify criterion stated: 'No PASS decision can slip through at confidence 50.'

key.name: Coverage attribution + safety rotation disguise detection
key.steps: 1) Factorized attention transformer computes frame-by-frame assignment probabilities P_assign in R^{11x20} over 20 discrete defensive coverage assignments and attention-weighted bipartite matching M in [0,1]^{11x5} (defender<->receiver pairing) from pre-snap through release; 2) compute disguise divergence D_disguise = D_KL(P_coverage(t_post)||P_coverage(t_snap)); 3) monitor kinematic centroid and differential velocity of FS/SS via R_safety(t) sigma(w^T[...]) to lock true post-snap coverage identity before pass release (R_safety > 0.85 within 400 ms of snap).

key.name: Factorized spatial-temporal attention block
key.steps: 1) Input x (B,T,A,D). 2) Spatial: x_spatial = x.view(B*T, A, D); spatial_out,_ = self.spatial_attn(x_spatial, x_spatial, x_spatial); x = x + norm1(spatial_out.view(B,T,A,D)). 3) Temporal: x_temporal = x.transpose(1,2).reshape(B*A, T, D); temporal_out,_ = self.temporal_attn(x_temporal, x_temporal, x_temporal); temporal_out = temporal_out.view(B,A,T,D).transpose(1,2); x = x + norm2(temporal_out). 4) FFN: x = x + norm3(ffn(x)); ffn = Linear(D,4D) -> GELU -> Linear(4D,D) -> Dropout. 5) Tensor shape preserved (self-attention Q=K=V). Modeled on coverage-assignment transformer reporting 89%+ accuracy.

key.name: KOWCPI — Kernel-based Optimally Weighted Conformal Time-Series Prediction (Lee, Xu, Xie 2024; arXiv:2405.16828)
key.steps: Adapt the classic Reweighted Nadaraya-Watson (RNW) estimator for quantile regression on dependent data; assign kernel-based weights by temporal proximity (more recent observations receive higher weight) instead of treating all calibration points equally; learn the weights optimally from data rather than fixed a priori. Achieves narrower confidence intervals without losing coverage vs state-of-the-art methods on real time-series data. Establishes conditional-coverage guarantees for non-exchangeable data under strong mixing conditions on the nonconformity scores.

key.name: L0–L8 reasoning stack (card pipeline)
key.steps: L0 signal (measured value with source, timestamp, verification tier) → L1 observation (signal vs baseline) → L2 primitive (named mechanism) → L3 composite mechanism → L4 causal chain (signal→L2→L2→L2→play-level effect, every link cited/falsifiable) → L5 thesis (named causal claim) → L6 adversarial thesis → L7 portfolio (correlation, concentration, Kelly-fraction sizing) → L8 meta-reasoning (self-audit). Rule: only L6+ qualifies as reasoning; only L7+ as a portfolio; only L8 self-improving. Each card must run ≥3 of 6 reasoning modes: inductive, deductive, abductive, analogical, counterfactual, Bayesian.

key.name: Impute-then-predict + conformalization under missing values (Zaffran, Dieuleveut, Josse, Romano 2023; arXiv:2306.02732)
key.steps: Impute missing covariates, then apply standard conformalization. First positive result: marginal coverage holds on imputed data for any missingness distribution (including MNAR) and almost all imputation functions — if (A1) the data satisfy exchangeability and (A2) the imputation function satisfies symmetry, then the imputed random variables are exchangeable and the standard conformal guarantee holds. Missing values induce heteroskedasticity; coverage can vary dramatically across missingness patterns (masks); mask-conditional calibration methods are proposed for the harder conditional-coverage problem.

key.name: Frozen GSE n=5 vs n=500 operational plan at alpha=0.10
key.steps: n=5: engine must emit an infinite interval or No-Bet; clamping to max(n)=5 is banned (yields 5/6 ~ 83.33% true coverage, 6.67% under-coverage defect); split CQR prohibited whenever n < 9; substitute Jackknife+ (1-2alpha) and/or SPI. Binary sides: compute Venn-Abers bounds via dual isotonic regressions and refuse if p1-p0 > 0.20. n=500: split CQR operational at rank index 451; use SPCI or rolling-origin conformal for serial dependence; ACI for drift; PAVA isotonic regression with pre-coalesced tied scores; Mondrian (subgroup) calibration across leagues/prop types; audit against Brier and ECE<=0.05.

key.name: Glicko-2 rating-period design options for NFL
key.steps: Week-as-Period: 18 discrete periods/season; because teams play at most once per week the parallel update collapses mathematically into a sequential single-game update and \phi* = sqrt(\phi^2 + \sigma^2) is applied 17 times. Month-as-Period: 4 periods/season (4 games per period) - satisfies Glickman's structural criteria, eliminates intra-month ordering bias, reduces variance compounding. Season-as-Period: 1 period; all 17 games evaluated against opening pre-season ratings, discarding temporal ordering. Empirical comparison status: UNRUN; command: python3 -c "from data.analyze_glicko_period import run_period_study; run_period_study('data/games_all.csv', season=2024)"

key.name: ByteTrack two-pass Hungarian association (8-step frame cycle)
key.steps: 1) Propagate all active tracklets one time step via Kalman F; 2) partition detections D_k into D_high (conf>0.50) and D_low (0.10<conf<=0.50), discard conf<=0.10; 3) Pass 1: Hungarian on cost C=1-IoU between active tracks and D_high, matched pairs meeting IoU>=tau_high get strong Kalman updates; 4) isolate residual unmatched tracks T_rem; 5) Pass 2: second Hungarian on T_rem x D_low with same IoU cost, matched tracks updated with inflated measurement noise R_k ~ 1/max(conf_j,0.05); 6) unmatched D_low permanently discarded (no track birth); 7) unmatched D_high birth new tracks; 8) tracks still unmatched enter 30-frame coasting buffer before pruning (max_coast=30).

key.name: Jackknife+ (Barber, Candès, Ramdas, Tibshirani 2019; arXiv:1905.02928)
key.steps: Given training data (X_i, Y_i), i=1..n, and test point X_{n+1}: 1) compute leave-one-out predictions μ̂_{−i}(X_{n+1}) for each i; 2) construct the interval [α-th quantile of {μ̂_{−i}(X_{n+1}) − |Y_i − μ̂_{−i}(X_i)|}, (1−α)-th quantile of {μ̂_{−i}(X_{n+1}) + |Y_i − μ̂_{−i}(X_i)|}]. Guarantee: at least 1−2α coverage regardless of the data distribution, for any algorithm that treats training points symmetrically. Fixes the original jackknife (interval centered at the predicted response, width from quantiles of leave-one-out residuals), which 'can have zero coverage for certain algorithms'. Connects to cross-conformal prediction (Vovk 2015) and extends to K-fold cross-validation.

key.name: Failure-taxonomy audit (12 checks before publishing a card)
key.steps: Audit each card against 12 failure modes and resolve: 1 Template (links repeat, names swapped); 2 Coverage (domains counted not interacted); 3 Correlation (correlated signals multiplied as independent — consult interaction matrix, not just copula); 4 Stale data (label capture timestamps, downgrade tier); 5 Contamination (nested data, wrong attribution — roster cross-check every ingest); 6 Overfit (LRs in-sample — calibration ledger, holdout test); 7 Silent assumption (every LR gets MEASURED/COMPUTED/REPORTED/ASSUMED); 8 Narrative (mechanism wrong); 9 Anchor (market over/under-reliance); 10 Disguise (pretend-scheme vs real-scheme; prefer post-snap tendency); 11 Base rate (report base rate alongside thesis); 12 Adversarial (mandatory counter-thesis). Any unaddressed mode = card is a draft.

key.name: Nested conformal prediction / QOOB (Gupta, Kuchibhotla, Ramdas 2019; arXiv:1910.10562)
key.steps: Reverse the standard CP direction: start from a collection of nested sets F_t(x) = {y : score(x,y) ≤ t} and calibrate the threshold t. Shown that CQR's nonconformity score max{q̂_α/2(X_i) − Y_i, Y_i − q̂_{1−α/2}(X_i)} can be recovered exactly from the nested-set perspective. QOOB ('cube') = quantile regression + cross-conformalization + ensemble methods + out-of-bag predictions; uses multiple splits and out-of-bag predictions so all data serve both training and calibration (avoids the statistical inefficiency of single data splitting). Unifies cross-conformal, jackknife+, and other data-efficient conformal methods; supports designing new methods by choosing the geometric shape of the prediction region first, then deriving the corresponding nonconformity score.

key.steps: L1 market anchor: take line as Bayesian prior; never claim to beat it. L2 signal aggregation: for each play enumerate touching signals; compute cross-domain correlations (example chain: air density → deep pass efficiency → WR over; Ed-Oliver-out → interior pressure → clean pocket → QB over yards → WR over → SGP correlation). Output layer: ALWAYS a ranked board (ranked plays, fades, copula-corrected parlays, reasoning trace, sizing, fleet-bus broadcast) — 'Never output PASS as terminal. Always rank. Tail is fine.'

key.name: Eleven-section card output contract
key.steps: Every card, in order: Header (game, date, thesis name, conviction RANGE not point); Thesis Statement (one sentence, falsifiable, named mechanism); Causal Chain (L4, each link cited + falsifier); Confluence Analysis (independent domains touching the mechanism; others to a 'Context' subsection labeled 'does not drive the thesis'); Precedent (named games from the 1,088-game corpus, structural similarity, outcome distribution, else named gap); Projected Game State (first-15 script, halftime trajectory, second-half adaptation, prop conditioning); Counter-Thesis (named mechanism + falsifiers); Breaking Conditions (pre-registered, both sides, numeric where possible); Bayesian Layer (prior source, LR table with tier, posterior, explicit list of 'signals reasoned over but not applied to the posterior'); Honest Limits; Sizing (Kelly-fraction, bankroll-aware, correlation-adjusted, concentration-named). key.name: CV film pipeline (8 stages)
key.steps: 1) Capture: Windows watcher grabs broadcast frames on a schedule around game windows; timestamped JPEG + game id. 2) Detect: YOLO detector -> per-frame boxes (x, y, w, h) + confidence (~22 detections/frame); swappable behind contract (repo holds contract, not weights). 3) Track: IoU + motion-aware association links boxes across frames into tracklets (persistent id, team side, position history). 4) Stabilize: optical flow estimates camera motion per frame pair and subtracts it (camera motion field dx, dy). 5) Map to field: yard-line detection + homography -> real-world meters on goal-line-origin field. 6) Measure: distanceM, topSpeedMs, avgSpeedMs + per-frame speed series (time-to-top-speed etc.). 7) Understand: play segmentation (pre-snap/snap/live/whistle); formation classify; route template match (conf, break point, depth); separation at break/catch vs nearest defender; jersey OCR to roster. 8) Learn (shadow): film features (routeMix, targetShareByFormation, avgSep, tendencies) -> film_shadow_ledger, weight 0.

key.steps: Roles: 4 statisticians, 4 football analysts, 4 skeptics, 4 synthesizers (synthesizers read only other agents' outputs). Phase 1 MAP: walk full tree, catalog total files read, categories, duplicates; list unread files explicitly, never silently skip. Phase 2 EXTRACT per doc: (a) method/signal in one sentence, (b) math/estimator, (c) dataset and sample size, (d) claimed result with metric, (e) license/provenance, (f) GSE relevance HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NONE. Phase 3 SYNTHESIZE: which signals compound; which claims contradict and which side has stronger evidence; rank top 25 by expected GSE value; list what is already standard practice. Phase 4 CHALLENGE each of top 25: overfit? out-of-sample? transfers to NFL? admission test = shuffled-time placebo + adds value beyond the betting market + threshold tuned on a disjoint fold; kill ruthlessly. Phase 5 DELIVER build list ordered by expected value: what to build, source file paths, implementation sketch (code, data in, number out), the test that proves it (held-out check, metric, bar), shadow or publish-ready.

key.name: CQR — split conformalized quantile regression (Romano, Patterson, Candès 2019; arXiv:1905.03222)
key.steps: 1) Train two quantile regressors at levels α/2 and 1−α/2 on a proper training set. 2) Compute conformity scores on a calibration set: E_i = max{q̂_α/2(X_i) − Y_i, Y_i − q̂_{1−α/2}(X_i)} — 'how far the true response falls outside the estimated quantile band'. 3) At test time, expand the quantile band by the (1−α)(1+1/n)-th empirical quantile of the calibration scores: C(x) = [q̂_α/2(x) − Q̂_{1−α}(E), q̂_{1−α/2}(x) + Q̂_{1−α}(E)]. Guarantee: P(Y ∈ C(X)) ≥ 1−α under exchangeability. Inherits 'full adaptivity to heteroscedasticity from quantile regression, and finite-sample valid coverage from conformal prediction'; intervals are 'wider where noise is higher, narrower where predictions are more certain'. Limitations: requires training a quantile regression model ('challenging with limited data or complex architectures'); assumes exchangeability — 'unsuitable for time series without modification'.
